Xixi Wetland Park: Hangzhou's Natural Oasis - A Traveler's Guide

Publication Date: Sep 01, 2025

Introduction
Xixi National Wetland Park, a sprawling natural haven located just a stone's throw from the bustling city of Hangzhou, offers a tranquil escape into a world of lush greenery, serene waterways, and diverse wildlife. The park is known as "the kidney of Hangzhou," fulfilling a vital role in the city's ecosystem.

History and Ecological Significance
Xixi's history dates back over 1,000 years, with evidence of human activity and settlements throughout its vast expanse. Originally a farming and fishing area, it was later recognized for its ecological importance and designated a national wetland park in 2005. The park provides essential flood control and water purification for Hangzhou.

Why it's a Must-Visit
Unlike manicured gardens, Xixi Wetland Park offers a more immersive and authentic experience of nature. Visitors can lose yourself in the labyrinthine waterways, observe rare bird species, and appreciate the beauty of the changing seasons. The park's unique blend of natural beauty and cultural heritage sets it apart from other attractions.

Exploring the Park
Xixi National Wetland Park is vast, covering over 11 square kilometers. The most popular way to explore Xixi is by boat. Several boat tour options are available, ranging from small, traditional gondolas to larger, motorized vessels. Alternatively, numerous walking paths meander through the park. Consider renting a bicycle for faster exploration.

Key Attractions
The Xixi Plum Villa: A traditional Chinese garden showcasing plum blossoms in the spring.
The Yanshui Fishing Village: A reconstructed village offering a glimpse into the area's fishing history.
The Dragon Boat Culture Center: Dedicated to the history and traditions of dragon boat racing.

Wildlife
Birdwatching is a popular activity, especially during migration seasons. Keep an eye out for kingfishers, herons, and egrets. You might even spot some of the park's more elusive residents, such as the masked palm civet.

Tips for Visiting
Best Time: Spring and autumn offer the most pleasant weather.
Entrance Fees: ¥80/adult (¥40 for students/seniors). Free for children under 1.2m.
Transportation: Several bus lines connect the park to various parts of Hangzhou.
Book boat tours in advance, especially during peak season.
Bring binoculars for optimal birdwatching.

sources.content:
Xixi National Wetland Park Travel Guide 2026

Xixi National Wetland Park is the first national wetland park in China to integrate urban, agricultural, and cultural wetlands, and is also a prestigious AAAAA-rated tourist destination. Located in the West Lake District of Hangzhou, the park spans about 100 kilometers of rivers, with approximately 70% of its area covered by streams, ponds, lakes, and marshes.

Best Time to Visit: Spring (March to May) and autumn (September to November). Spring offers mild temperatures and blooming flowers, ideal for birdwatching and nature walks.

Key Attractions: The Three Dikes and Ten Scenes are signature attractions. There are over 3000 plum trees and a concentrated plum forest of more than 300 acres.

Transportation: Take the Subway Line 3, alight at Xixi Wetland South Station, exit from Exit A. 5-minute walk to the park entrance.

Ticket prices: 80 RMB per person; areas like Hezhu Street and Fudi are free to enter.

Opening Hours: April 1 to October 7: 7:30 AM – 6:30 PM. October 8 to March 31: 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM.

Electric Boat: CNY 60 per person. Sculling Boat: CNY 100 per hour (up to 6 people).

Duration: 4-6 hours for main scenic spots, or a whole day for in-depth experience.

By November, 300 acres of reed flowers bloom in a soft white haze. The Plum Blossom Festival (Mid-February to Mid-March) marks the beginning of spring.

sources.title: Xixi National Wetland Park, Hangzhou: Attractions, Activities & Map
sources.content:
Xixi National Wetland Park, Hangzhou: Attractions, Activities & Map

Xixi National Wetland Park is a beautiful lake landscape located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China.

When stepping into Xixi National Wetland Park, visitors feel calm right away, with waterways twisting through green fields and tall reeds, wooden bridges and small islands creating perfect spots for sightseeing and relaxing.

Taking an electric boat or sculling boat to Xixi Plum Blossom Villa offers a rural experience. The whole route is about 8km long and takes more than 3 and a half hours.

Walking is a good way to explore the park more deeply, starting from Zhoujia Village and walking to Plum and Bamboo Manor, then turning to Anchorage Thatching and Hazy Fisher Village to feel local folk customs.

The park is the birthplace of Chinese South Opera, and visitors can visit old stages and learn about this art form.

By Subway: Line 5 to "Xixi Wetland East Station" (Exit A), 10-minute walk. By Bus: Routes 193, 356, or B4D.

sources.title: Xixi Wetland Park: Guide to Boating, Birdwatching & Trails
sources.content:
Xixi Wetland Park: Guide to Boating, Birdwatching & Trails

Xixi National Wetland Park is vast, covering over 11 square kilometers. Navigating its expanse requires a bit of planning, but the rewards are well worth the effort.

There are four wharfs in the park where you can buy tickets for electric boats. The boat will have a stop at every wharf so you can get off to enjoy the beautiful scenery. The ticket is CNY 60 per person.

Renting a sculling boat gives you a rather free tour - you can choose to turn in any direction you want. The rental fee is CNY 100 per hour, and one boat can hold up to 6 people.

If you only visit the main scenic spots, it takes about 4-6 hours. If you want to experience it in depth, it is recommended to spend a whole day.

sources.title: Xixi National Wetland Park - A Rare Urban Oasis in Hangzhou
sources.content:
Xixi National Wetland Park - A Rare Urban Oasis in Hangzhou

Xixi National Wetland Park is one of Hangzhou's top attractions, offering a unique blend of natural beauty and cultural heritage just a short distance from the city center.

The park features 300 acres of plum forest with over 20,000 plum trees, featuring the "Meandering Water Plum Search." Punt boat rides are best booked in advance.

The park is a dream for bird lovers, with many birds calling this place home. Visitors can spot egrets flying in groups or white cranes standing in the water.

The Plum Blossom Festival (Mid-February to Mid-March) marks the beginning of spring with boat rides, quiet moments, and festive excitement.

sources.content:
浙江杭州西溪国家湿地公园信息总览

基本信息
位于浙江省杭州市西湖区天目山路518号，规划总面积11.5平方千米。中国第一个集城市湿地、农耕湿地、文化湿地于一体的国家级湿地公园，首个国家5A级湿地景区。

历史沿革
西溪古称河渚，历史可追溯至公元前5000年新石器时代。东晋时被发现，南宋时期成为皇家狩猎场。明清时期演变为私家园林。2005年建成开园，2012年获评5A级景区。

地理环境
水文特征：河流总长约100千米，约70%面积为河港、池塘、湖漾、沼泽等水域。
气候：属亚热带季风气候，年平均气温15.17℃，年均降水1399毫米。

生态资源
截至2024年底，记录维管束植物971种、昆虫918种、鸟类224种。包括东方白鹳、白尾海雕、鸳鸯等保护动物。

主要景点
福堤：全长2300米，宽7米，以六座带福字的桥连接
绿堤：东西向长堤，全长1600米
寿堤：最长堤道，约3600米
秋雪庵：始建宋淳熙年间，全国诗词研究基地
河渚街：民俗商业街，展示西溪物产与文化
高庄：清代文人山庄别业
深潭口：民俗文化展示中心，龙舟胜会举办地

文化活动
西溪探梅节（2-3月）、西溪花朝节（4-5月）、西溪龙舟文化节（端午）、西溪火柿节（9-10月）、西溪听芦节（10-11月）

旅游信息
门票：80元/人（部分区域免费）
开放时间：4月1日-10月7日 07:30-18:30；10月8日-次年3月31日 08:00-17:30
交通：地铁3号线（西溪湿地南站），19号线（西溪湿地北站）

重要里程碑
2009年7月：列入国际重要湿地名录
2015年2月：获"国家生态旅游示范区"称号
2019年10月：马云公益基金会捐赠1亿元用于保护
2025年5月：累计入园6500万人次，经营收入28亿元

Xixi National Wetland Park: Location, Opening Hours, Activities and Travel Info

Xixi National Wetland Park is suitable for visits all year round, but the best times are during spring (March to May) and autumn (September to November).

Opening Hours: April 1 to October 7: 7:30 AM – 6:30 PM, ticket sales end at 5:30 PM. October 8 to March 31: 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM, ticket sales end at 4:30 PM.

Admission: CNY 80 / Sightseeing Cruise: CNY 60. ¥80/adult (¥40 for students/seniors). Free for children under 1.2m.

Getting There: By Subway Line 3 to Xixi Wetland South Station (Exit A). By Bus: Routes 193, 356, or B4D to Xixi Wetland Zhoujia Village Stop.
